about.description: Bond-linked perpetual market tracking a U.S. bond benchmark. The contract gives synthetic exposure to bond-market price moves without ownership of any Treasury, bond fund share, coupon stream, or redemption claim. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDH. The market is visible on Hyperliquid under the km namespace, but it is operated by Markets by Kinetiq rather than listed as a core Hyperliquid perp.
